edits.old: Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003
edits.new:
Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003

  Scenario: AC4 Access refused (exception X2)
    Given a caller without the Write-off and posting right
    When the caller reads the feed outcome
    Then the system answers 403 before any read
    Then nothing changes and no record is written

  Scenario: AC5 No tax criteria version (exception X3)
    Given no tax criteria version is in force at the business date
    When the run arrives
    Then the step holds the case at PROVISION_RELEASED and writes nothing
    Then the system raises MSG-S7-001

  Scenario: AC6 Case not at PROVISION_RELEASED (exception X4)
    Given a case that is not at PROVISION_RELEASED or has left the population since it was read
    When the run arrives for that case
    Then the system answers 409 for that case and writes nothing for it
    Then a case that has already moved is not fed twice

  Scenario: AC7 Dependency does not answer (exception X5)
    Given rwb-case, rwb-decision or the reference-data read does not answer inside 2 s, or its breaker is open
    When the step runs
    Then the step retries on the workflow's own schedule and writes nothing
    Then the caller sees 503 with the platform error envelope

  Scenario: AC8 Finance feed rejects the file (exception X6, R-WO-27)
    Given the Finance provision feed rejects the file
    When the rejection is received
    Then R-WO-27 records the rejection code and answers FINANCE_FEED_REJECTED
    Then the two-working-day task is raised

  Scenario: AC9 Repeated run (exception X7, BR11)
    Given the same business date, population and package version arrive twice, or the same Idempotency-Key arrives twice
    When the repeat is received
    Then one record, one feed and one answer are produced per case
    Then the repeat is counted and the key answers the feed that exists

  Scenario: AC10 Boundary breach (exception X8)
    Given a component, a statement or a test reaches a v_ace_* view, a recovery_case row or another service's schema
    When the boundary test runs
    Then the grant refuses the statement and the build fails
    Then nothing is released

  Scenario: AC11 Feed row changed or absent (exception X9, MSG-GEN-001)
    Given the Finance feed row has changed since the last run or no row is in force at the business date
    When the next feed is built
    Then the next feed obeys the new version, or no feed is built
    Then the cases stay at PROVISION_RELEASED with the refusal in the run log

  Scenario: AC12 Provision inputs leave as feed items (BR1, BR4)
    Given the rwb-case contract mock returns the case at PROVISION_RELEASED
    When the feed is sent
    Then the provision inputs and the tax file leave as two items of the Finance provision feed
    Then the case move is answered and not written

  Scenario: AC13 Own rows only, no personal data (BR3, BR10)
    Given the posted population of the business date
    When the population is read
    Then only the write_off rows of this service are read
    Then no name, address, contact value or identity number enters a record, a feed item, a log or a workflow input

  Scenario: AC14 Tax criteria version as reference data (BR5, BR6)
    Given the reference data holds the tax criteria version with its version
    When the step runs
    Then the tax criteria version is read with its version
    Then no value a business person may change is written in code

  Scenario: AC15 Re-send after a cleared rejection (BR7, BR8, BR14, BR15)
    Given a case at FINANCE_FEED_REJECTED
    When an accepted re-send arrives
    Then the case returns to FINANCE_FEED_SENT under R-WO-28 and the tax file reference is recorded
    Then the feed status, the feed reference, the acceptance code and the tax file reference are held in the decision record and the case state

  Scenario: AC16 Month-end close as a durable timer (BR9)
    Given the month-end close of R-WO-26
    When the close arrives
    Then the close runs as a durable timer of WriteOffWorkflow and not as a Schedule

  Scenario: AC17 Decision recorded before anything leaves (BR2)
    Given the decision for the case is ready
    When the step runs
    Then the decision is recorded with the rule ID and the package version before anything leaves
    Then a failed write changes nothing and the caller sees MSG-P7-003
